topics.label: Lecture opening and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and objectives for the lecture on inflammation initiation and resolution.

topics.label: Innate pathogen and damage recognition by pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms by which the innate immune system senses microbial presence and tissue injury through pattern recognition receptors and downstream activation pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory response execution, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic escalation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how sentinel cell activation drives the cellular inflammatory response, leukocyte extravasation into tissues, lymphatic trafficking, and systemic outcomes such as septic shock.

topics.label: Inflammation resolution, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the immune system terminates inflammation, coordinates tissue healing, and handles persistent pathogens through chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding closing remarks and previews the topic of the subsequent lecture.
